gen-gf-turret-road-gf-national-park: Big, round, unshaded headlines come from Turret Road, whose bowls curve like open parentheses, while National Park writes the text in a pen-drawn sans with one open side. Try it at a generous heading size.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-niramit: Turret Road draws its heading in a single pen-like line, round forms curving like open parentheses and never swelling or thinning. And Niramit's body letters gape wide at every curve, giving the pair a lively, open texture.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-noto-sans-canadian: Noto Sans Canadian Aboriginal reads as a neutral, contemporary text face, with every curve ending in an open gap. Turret Road's bowls, though, stay full and unthinned, and that bold, commanding roundness is what you notice first.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-noto-sans-cypriot: Bold round headings, friendly text underneath.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-noto-sans-cypro-mi: Noto Sans Cypro Minoan reads as contemporary and businesslike, its terminals cut back to leave a big gap. And Turret Road's heavy, uniform letter parts give the pair its strongest quality: a firm, bold heading over open text.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-noto-sans-hanifi-r: Noto Sans Hanifi Rohingya brings an approachable, modern voice, with a c that gapes visibly at any size. Turret Road's job is the bold, unshaded heading; Noto Sans Hanifi Rohingya's is the friendly text beneath it.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-noto-sans-hatran: Turret Road holds its heading in the steady line of a technical drafting pen, bold and commanding. And Noto Sans Hatran, with its funnel-wide e, keeps a longer read approachable and easy going.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-noto-sans-inscript: Noto Sans Inscriptional Pahlavi reads contemporary and approachable, with small counters that never clog. Turret Road earns its keep big and short, where bars as heavy as its stems look commanding.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-noto-sans-javanese: Neutral is the mood of Noto Sans Javanese, whose apertures keep every counter connected to the space outside, under Turret Road's bold, commanding heading. Over a long stretch it reads smoothly.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-noto-sans-linear-a: Clean is the word for Noto Sans Linear A, its c gaping visibly at any size beneath Turret Road's rope-thick, bold curves. Longer text moves along with an easy, open rhythm.
